senses.gloss: f. (preced. wds.) grazing, esp. grazing until natural death to which sacrificial animals are eventually condemned, v. סָאַב.
units: <cite ref="Zevachim 5b">Zeb. 5ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 112a">112ᵃ</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="N01387"><he>נָתַק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yoma 66a:2">Yoma 66ᵃ</cite> <he>לר׳ אזלא</he> goes to pasture until death; a. e.—Pl. <he>רְעִיּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Yoma 66a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>כל ר׳</he> all animals condemned to pasture.
